name: IoT panel
purpose: Device cards with status badges, load gauges, and trend charts.
scenarios: Scan online, alert, and offline devices
Acknowledge an alert to return a device to online
Show an empty state when no devices are connected

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for bundled block copy.

onAcknowledge.description: Called when an alert device is acknowledged.

variants.name: density
variants.description: Inherits density from token rungs rather than a local viewport query.

states.name: default
states.description: Devices are present and none are alerting.

states.name: alert
states.description: At least one device is alerting.

antiPatterns: Do not present this template as a live SCADA or twin runtime.
Do not size the device grid with viewport width media queries.

keyboard: Tab reaches badges, gauges, charts, and acknowledge actions
a11y.focus: Acknowledge stays in document order with a visible focus ring.
a11y.labeling: Gauges and charts include the device name; badges name the status.

responsive.strategy: Device cards stack; @container at 48rem places three columns. No viewport media queries.

breakpoints.medium: Cards become three columns at 48rem container inline-size.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction comes from locale language.
